rooms.name: Outside Kingly Kebab
rooms.description: You are outside the front door of Kingly Kebab, neon light spilling onto the wet pavement.

rooms.name: Staff Alley
rooms.description: You are in the narrow staff alley behind the takeaway. Bins, crates, and the smell of old chips.

rooms.name: Stock Room
rooms.description: You are in the cramped stock room: boxes of sauces, spare menus, and random junk piled everywhere.

items.name: Key
items.desc: A large golden key with ‘CL’ scratched into it. It probably opens something in the estate.

items.name: RustyKey
items.desc: A large rusty key with ‘CL’ scratched into it. It probably opens something in the estate.

rooms.name: Main Street West
rooms.description: You are on Main Street West. Shuttered shops and parked cars line the road.

rooms.name: Main Street East
rooms.description: You are on Main Street East, closer to the estates. An off-licence hums with low music nearby.

rooms.name: Park Entrance
rooms.description: You are at the entrance to a dimly lit park. Trees arch overhead and a path winds into the darkness.

rooms.name: Dark Park
rooms.description: You are deep in the park. It’s so dark that without extra light you feel like you could get lost.

items.name: Chalk
items.desc: A stub of white chalk. Perfect for marking walls so you don’t get lost.

rooms.name: Estate Entrance
rooms.description: You are at the entrance to Crooked Lane estate. Identical houses sprawl in every direction.

rooms.name: Twisty Junction
rooms.description: You are at a junction of narrow estate roads. Every corner looks weirdly similar.

rooms.name: North Street
rooms.description: You are on a silent residential street. The same type of semi-detached houses repeat endlessly.

rooms.name: Deep Street
rooms.description: You are on a deeper stretch of road in the estate. It feels like you are further from civilisation.

rooms.name: Dizzy Street
rooms.description: You are at a strange corner where the houses seem to shift when you’re not looking.

rooms.name: Shadow Alley
rooms.description: You are in a narrow alley between houses. It’s quiet, and you see your shadow in each window.

rooms.name: South Street
rooms.description: You are on a street ending at a tall metal gate to the south. A small sign reads ‘Private walkway’.

south.msg: The tall metal gate is locked. The golden key marked 'CL' might open it.
south.msg_unlock: You unlock the tall metal gate with the golden key.
south.msg_unlock_fail: The key doesn't fit the lock on the tall metal gate.

rooms.name: Garden Path
rooms.description: You are on a narrow garden path that winds behind the houses. A single house light glows ahead.

rooms.name: Customer's House
rooms.description: You are outside No. 14 Crooked Lane, your customer’s house. Warm light spills from behind the curtains.

npcs.name: Bob
npcs.desc: An overweight man, eating a doner kebab.
npcs.conversation_piece: I haven't seen any delivery drivers around here lately...

npcs.name: Guard
npcs.conversation_piece: Move along or i'll arrest you.
